text: I feel a gentle curiosity as I move from a quiet, modern hallway—its reflection multiplying possibilities—into a vibrant exhibition space devoted to research and development. The transition from emptiness to an environment saturated with information and color invites contemplation. Here, I sense a pulse of creativity and human endeavor, and I am alert to the invitation to ponder how our collective innovations shape the world. Yet, I also feel a slight disorientation, as the visual angles tilt my perspective and challenge me to find orientation both physically and mentally.
